keyFindings.description: lock.sh:22 re-opens fd 9 in a series' run-step.sh child, which then fails flock, closes fd 9 and passes on the token; neither that step nor its loadgen holds the lock, so killing run-series.sh frees the root while its step still runs, and a second run-step.sh is admitted and resets the stack under it. Reproduced by the deep review with lock.sh alone. Fix: return before re-opening when LOADTEST_LOCK_TOKEN equals the file's token; add a run-step.test.sh case.

guard.go:197-201: under -allow-foreign an empty -pg, -pprof, -nats-mon (or -listener/-nats) falls back to the local stack.json, so a cluster run that names only -url counts commits and samples the local stack while writes go to the remote one, silently. Require every endpoint flag under -allow-foreign.

run.go:485,493 restarts markers at lgm1x every run and delivery.go:128,206-214 joins loadtest.event_commits by marker, so a `stack.sh loadgen run` (documented as taking no lock and needing no reset) after an earlier run counts the old run's rows as this run's commits. Make markers unique per run (nonce) or bound commit rows to this run.
